svg.title: Release abandoned holds
svg.desc: Milestone 3 overview. Each new hold gets a wall-clock deadline that the reply reports; when it passes, an unconfirmed hold expires and its seats become available, even if the deadline passed while the service was stopped. Confirmed bookings keep their seats. Upgrades keep earlier reservations, and the service runs in a container whose data volume outlives the container. The API, routes, reservation book, database setup, Reservation API, reserved seats and reservations change; the container, data volume, Dockerfile, runtime settings and checks are new. Gray means context, blue means changed and green means new.
svg.text: Proposed milestone 3 • Deadlines are wall-clock times, so downtime counts and the data volume keeps them.
